units.text: The dome glows with a frozen field of stars.
Rows of reclining seats, one of them occupied by a dead man in a tuxedo.

DET. ISADORA FENN (40s, rain-slick trench) crouches by the body while patrolman OKAFOR (20s, notebook) points his flashlight at the carpet, the museum director MR. HALVERSEN (60s, silk scarf, trembling) hovers by the doors, and a tall STRANGER (30s, charcoal suit, no umbrella) lingers at the back, watching all of them.
Nobody touches the console. Nobody leaves the dome.
units.name: FENN

units.text: He was only here to give a lecture. On Orion.
units.name: HALVERSEN

units.text: Photograph his hands. He's gripping something.
units.name: FENN

units.text: The dead man's fingers hold a small brass key.
Fenn turns to the back row.
Anselm Rook. I was his guest.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Mr. Rook, you're standing very still for a man whose host just died.
units.name: FENN

units.text: I'm counting. The stars on the dome are wrong. Somebody reprogrammed the sky.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: Fenn looks up and sees it too: one constellation reversed.
That's not Orion. That's a signature.
units.name: FENN
